name: TC-55 Registration — phone format — Реєстрація modal (invalid phone format).

steps.name: 1.Click the user icon in the site header.
Open user profile menu
Return whether user profile dropdown is displayed.
2.Click 'Зареєструватися' in the dropdown.
Click 'Зареєструватися' in user menu
Check if Registration modal is displayed
Check if Registration modal is displayed
3.Observe the role selection.
Check if 'Відвідувач' role is selected
4. Fill all fields with valid data except 'Телефон'
Enter First Name (Ім'я): ''Петро''
Enter Last Name (Прізвище): ''Іванов''
Enter Email: ''petro.visitor.qa@example.com''
Enter Password (Пароль)
Enter Confirm Password (Підтвердження паролю)
Check whether successful icon for First Name is visible
Check whether successful icon for Last Name is visible
Check whether successful icon for email is visible
Check whether successful icon for password is visible
Check whether successful icon for confirm password is visible
5.Enter an invalid phone suffix into the 'Телефон' field and observe the error
Enter Phone (Телефон): ''099 123 4567''
Get all displayed validation error messages in the form for phone field
Check whether validation error messages in the form for phone field is visible
Check whether error icon for phone is visible
Check whether successful icon for First Name is visible
Check whether successful icon for Last Name is visible
Check whether successful icon for email is visible
Check whether successful icon for password is visible
Check whether successful icon for confirm password is visible
